title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).


 This job was posted by Malavika Kannoth from ZOOP.

 Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology \- quickly and accurately. We apply problem\-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes \- all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.

description:

 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our infrastructure team with expertise across Cloud Deployments, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Office 365, Zerto, Rubrik, VMware, and NSX\-T. This hands\-on, automation\-heavy role focuses on system reliability, scalability, and proactive problem prevention. You will be responsible for building and maintaining resilient infrastructure, automating repetitive tasks, monitoring, and improving
   

  

 performance, and driving incident reduction strategies across hybrid cloud environments.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 
 (Additional duties may be assigned as required)
   

  

* Own the design and roadmap for hybrid identity (Entra ID and on\-prem AD), including conditional access and secure authentication standards.

* Design and maintain CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent).
* Own the automated vulnerability patch management program.
* Optimize Office 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune) for security and performance.
* Lead response and resolution for high\-impact incidents; act as on\-call escalation point.
* Conduct blameless postmortems and drive remediation to closure.
* Mentor SRE team members and review scripts, Terraform, and change plans.
* Represent infrastructure in security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO).


**REQUIRED SKILLS**
* 6–10 years in SRE on Windows\-based production environments, including ownership of platform reliability.
* Deep expertise in VMware (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, NSX\-T), including capacity planning and architecture design.
* Expert\-level Microsoft Entra ID and on\-prem Active Directory: hybrid identity design, conditional access strategy, identity protection, and troubleshooting at scale.
* Strong programming/scripting in Python and PowerShell, with the ability to build reusable automation frameworks and self\-healing mechanisms. Infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform, including module design and DRY principles.
* CI/CD and GitOps experience (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or equivalent).
* Designing and implementing observability: defining SLIs/SLOs and building dashboards and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK.
* DR design and ownership with Zerto and Rubrik, including RTO/RPO planning, DR testing, and compliance.
* Strong networking knowledge: virtual network topology design, firewalls, load balancing, and DNS.


**Preferred Skills**
* Production experience with AWS or Azure, including Secure Landing Zone design.
* Experience planning and executing workload migrations across VMware, AWS, and Azure.
* Kubernetes and Linux/Unix production experience.
* Ansible or similar configuration management tools.
* Experience owning vulnerability and patch management programs at scale.
* Experience supporting security and compliance audits (PCI, HIPAA, ISO).
* Relevant certifications (VCP, AZ\-104/AZ\-305, SC\-300, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or equivalent).
* Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical initiatives.
* Strong troubleshooting skills in complex hybrid environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting designs to stakeholders.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.

* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.

description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer, Real\-time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

 Principal Engineer, Real time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

**Overview**
 The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide.
   

  

 RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
   

  

 Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture \& technology leadership for multiple Real\-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
   

  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design \& architecture excellence
* Contributes \& drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology \& implementation decisions including all non\-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability


 The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
   

  

* Design \& Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering \& Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency \& Platform Evolution
* Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions.
* Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services.
* Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums.
* Engineering Leadership \& Bar Raising
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making.
* Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence.
* Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.


**All About You**
 Experience \& Technical Expertise
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale.
* Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms.
* Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures.
* Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling.
* Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.


 Technology Breadth
   

  

* Strong background in enterprise backend development with hands\-on experience across object\-oriented \& functional programming languages \- Java/Spring, React, Angular, Erlang
* Experience working across multiple technology stacks and system layers (application, messaging, data, platform).
* Familiarity with cloud and containerized environments; ability to operate effectively across heterogeneous market deployments.
* Payments or financial services experience (e.g., real time processing, regulated environments) is a strong plus.


 Leadership \& Ways of Working
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through technical credibility.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making high impact technical decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on long term platform health, not just short term delivery.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

*: 3–5 years, hands\-on* 




  





**We are hiring a Kafka and DevOps / Streaming Platform Engineer.** 




  





 At
 **VoiseTech** 
 , we are building a high\-scale AdTech platform designed to process billions of real\-time events every day. We are looking for an engineer who combines deep Apache Kafka experience with strong DevOps and infrastructure skills.
 



 This is not a role where Kafka is simply consumed as a managed cloud service. You will work close to the infrastructure — designing, deploying, operating, and performance\-tuning our streaming stack across self\-managed Kafka, Kubernetes, and dedicated bare\-metal infrastructure.
 



  





**What you will work with** 




 Apache Kafka \| Kafka KRaft \| Kubernetes \| Docker \| Linux \| ClickHouse \| Redis \| MongoDB \| FastAPI \| Prometheus \| Grafana \| CI/CD \| Bare Metal
 



 Exposure to Apache Flink is a strong plus.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 •       Deploy, configure, administer, and upgrade self\-managed Apache Kafka clusters
 



 •       Own Kafka topics, partitions, replication, retention, consumer groups, and capacity planning
 



 •       Diagnose production issues including consumer lag, broker failures, partition imbalance, rebalancing, and throughput bottlenecks
 



 •       Build and operate Kubernetes and Docker infrastructure for high\-throughput services
 



 •       Work with ClickHouse, Redis, and MongoDB infrastructure
 



 •       Benchmark systems for QPS, throughput, latency, network utilization, CPU, memory, and scalability
 



 •       Build monitoring, alerting, and observability using Prometheus and Grafana
 



 •       Automate infrastructure and operational workflows using Bash, Python, and CI/CD
 



 •       Participate in production troubleshooting, disaster recovery, and performance engineering
 



 •       Help us continuously improve reliability as traffic scales by orders of magnitude
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 You should have 3–5 years of hands\-on engineering experience, including meaningful production experience with Apache Kafka. We specifically want someone who has installed, configured, operated, and troubleshot Kafka clusters — not only developed Kafka producers and consumers.
 



 Strong fundamentals in Linux, networking, Docker/Kubernetes, and distributed systems are important. Experience with some of the following is a plus: Kafka KRaft, Flink, Kafka Connect, ClickHouse administration, Redis, MongoDB, Helm, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and bare\-metal infrastructure.
 



  





**How we think about AI** 




 We want engineers who are AI\-driven, not AI\-dependent. Use AI aggressively to move faster — investigation, automation, coding, debugging, and documentation — but understand the systems you operate, validate the output, and be capable of diagnosing production problems independently.
 



  





**Why this role is different** 




 You will not just maintain infrastructure. You will help build the streaming backbone of VoiseTech’s AdTech platform from the ground up, work on real high\-throughput distributed\-systems problems, and have end\-to\-end ownership from infrastructure to production performance.
 



  





 Interested? Send us your profile or reach out directly.

You will build MVPs, experiment with large language models and AI agents, and help convert ideas into working solutions quickly. You will work closely with senior engineers, product owners, and domain experts to test feasibility, iterate fast, and lay the groundwork for scalable AI systems. This is not a research\-only role. title: Security Consultant II
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Security Consultant owning VAPT and Red Teaming engagements across infrastructure, network, web, mobile, API, thick\-client, cloud and AI/LLM environments. The role involves identifying and exploiting security weaknesses, simulating real\-world adversary techniques, developing proof\-of\-concept exploits, documenting findings and providing clear remediation guidance to technical and business stakeholders. The consultant will also support purple\-team activities, mentor junior resources and contribute to offensive security capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing across infrastructure, network, web, mobile (Android/iOS), API, thick\-client and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Identify, validate and document vulnerabilities using manual testing techniques and automated security tools; develop PoCs to demonstrate exploitability.
* Conduct database security testing and configuration reviews across MySQL, Oracle and NoSQL platforms.
* Plan, execute and document Red Team engagements simulating real\-world threat actor TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Execute attack chains covering initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
* Conduct Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social\-engineering campaigns and endpoint security bypass exercises.
* Use and adapt adversary\-emulation tools and frameworks such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit and Caldera.
* Collaborate with Blue Teams during purple\-team exercises to validate and improve detection and response capabilities.
* Perform security testing of AI/ML and LLM\-based applications, including prompt injection, jailbreak, model extraction and adversarial\-input testing.
* Apply relevant AI security frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS to identify AI\-specific risks.
* Prepare detailed technical reports covering assessment methodology, vulnerabilities, severity, evidence, PoCs and remediation recommendations.
* Present security findings and risk implications clearly to technical teams, management and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, APT techniques, malware trends and offensive\-security research and incorporate relevant techniques into assessments.
* Mentor junior consultants on penetration\-testing tools, techniques and methodologies and contribute to internal security capability building.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in VAPT, Red Teaming and Application Security, including client\-facing or security advisory exposure.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OSSTMM, NIST and CIS security frameworks.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP, and network/infrastructure security.
* Hands\-on experience with penetration\-testing and vulnerability\-assessment tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nikto, ZAP and MobSF.
* Ability to perform manual penetration testing beyond automated scanner capabilities.
* Working experience with scripting and exploit development using Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Working knowledge of security assessment across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
* Strong analytical, technical documentation, report\-writing and client communication skills.
* BE/B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification.
* Ability to communicate security risks and remediation requirements effectively with technical and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* OSCP, OSCE, CRTP, eWPTX, CREST\-CRT or Security\+ certification.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI/LLM security testing and frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
* Experience with advanced Red Teaming and adversary\-emulation techniques.
* Exposure to Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social engineering and endpoint bypass techniques.
* Experience participating in purple\-team engagements and working with Blue/SOC teams.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Senior QA Engineer / Contractor (AI \& Data Platforms)
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Senior QA Engineer to join our foundational data and AI platform team. In this role, you will be responsible for defining and executing comprehensive testing strategies for complex, cutting\-edge foundational services. You will validate multi\-tenant APIs, vector databases, knowledge graphs, LLM integration pipelines, Dataiku data science workflows, and agentic platforms. Your focus will be on building robust automated testing frameworks, ensuring high availability, and verifying data accuracy and security across our entire enterprise AI stack consumed by internal Client teams.

* Designs, builds, and executes rigorous automated test strategies for foundational services, including vector databases, knowledge graphs, APIs, and LLM\-based applications.

* Tests multi\-tenant security boundaries, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), and authentication mechanisms across cloud\-managed and self\-managed backends.

* Develops and documents QA standards, test scenarios, and validation scripts aligned with enterprise governance and data compliance requirements.
* Engages in performance profiling, stress testing under concurrent user loads, and validating system recovery and failover behaviour.


**Technology**
* Graph Databases: Neo4j (Enterprise, Cypher, Causal Clustering) and exploration of alternative graph options.
* Testing Frameworks \& Tools: PyTest, Selenium/Playwright, RestAssured, Postman, JMeter / k6 for load testing.
* Data \& AI Stack: Vector Databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j), LLM Orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and Dataiku.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
* Programming \& Scripting: Python or Java for test automation script development.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure (Azure Marketplace, AKS, Azure VMs, Managed Disks, Key Vault, VNet peering).


**Previous Experience And Competencies**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline.
* 6 – 10 years of strong QA engineering experience with a heavy focus on backend services, APIs, and data platforms.
* Proven experience testing modern AI/ML workloads, vector search systems, or graph\-based data architectures.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep hands\-on experience writing robust automation scripts in Python.
* Familiarity with testing non\-deterministic outputs of Large Language Models (LLMs) and evaluating Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline quality.
* Systematic problem\-solving approach, strong analytical mindset, and acute attention to detail.
* Experience working within platform engineering or foundational infrastructure teams.


**Behaviour**
* Fosters and maintains excellent internal client and team relationships.
* Possesses a high degree of initiative and hands\-on execution drive.
* Adaptable and willing to learn new technologies; keeps abreast of key developments in relevant database and cloud ecosystems.
* Able to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent oral, written communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Practices effective listening techniques and collaborates well across cross\-functional groups.
* Able to work independently or as part of an empowered technical team.
* Effectively analyses and solves complex technical problems with meticulous attention to root cause.

title: Pune | Enablement Test SME IRC301884
description:
**Description**
 The Test SME brings AI\-native quality engineering expertise to the enablement squad. They transform how squads approach testing — moving from manual, labour\-intensive test practices to AI\-augmented quality workflows where Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) generates test cases, identifies coverage gaps, and maintains regression suites, enabling squads to ship faster with higher confidence.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Strong quality engineering background with experience across unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end testing strategies
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling — Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline, Aider): writing custom skills for test automation, building subagents for coverage analysis, and configuring MCP servers for test infrastructure
   

  

 Experience with modern test frameworks and tooling (Jest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar) and the ability to integrate AI tooling alongside them
   

  

 Understanding of AI\-native SDLC practices and how testing must evolve when code is generated or augmented by AI
   

  

 Experience with test architecture at scale — knowing when to test, what to test, and how to maintain fast feedback loops in large codebases
   

  

 Ability to coach engineers on testing practices — shifting quality left and making testing a shared responsibility rather than a bottleneck
   

  

 Comfortable assessing unfamiliar codebases and quickly identifying the highest\-impact quality improvements
   

  

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
 Experience with property\-based testing, mutation testing, or formal verification approaches
   

  

 Background in performance or reliability engineering (load testing, chaos engineering, SRE practices)
   

  

 Familiarity with contract testing in microservice architectures (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract)
   

  

 Experience in financial services quality assurance (regulatory testing requirements, audit trails)
   

  

 Experience defining and tracking quality metrics (defect escape rate, test cycle time, coverage trends)
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Assess the engineering team’s current testing maturity during the discovery phase — identifying gaps in coverage, slow feedback loops, and manual bottlenecks that block rapid delivery
   

  

 Design and implement AI\-native testing strategies: using Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) to generate test cases from requirements, analyse coverage gaps, and detect regression risks
   

  

 Build custom Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) skills and subagents focused on quality engineering — automated test generation, test data management, and intelligent test selection
   

  

 Define quality gates within the AI\-native SDLC that provide fast, automated feedback without creating delivery drag
   

  

 Embed testing best practices into product squads through pairing, code review, and hands\-on demonstration
   

  

 Create reusable testing patterns (frameworks, templates, agent configurations) that are made centrally available for use across all engineering teams
   

  

 Work alongside squad developers to ensure AI\-generated code meets quality standards and that testing keeps pace with accelerated delivery

title: Specialist Cloud Database Engineer (SQL, DevOps, AWS)
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
   

  

**Database DevOps \& Release Engineer**
**So, what’s the role all about?**
 We're hiring a Database DevOps \& Release Engineer for our Data Engineering and Database Operations team. This role goes beyond traditional DBA work: you'll need strong SQL and T\-SQL skills, working knowledge of DevOps and GitOps principles, and ownership of how database changes get built, reviewed, packaged, and deployed.
   

  

 You'll review and approve pull requests for database changes, package those changes (DDL, stored procedures, functions, and CLR/assembly changes) into deployable artifacts using DACPAC, SLN, and manifest files, and build and manage the CI/CD pipelines that deploy them alongside production application code. You'll also handle database support for our lower and lab environments, so replication, high availability, and backup/restore skills matter as much as your DevOps background.
   

  

**How will you make an impact?**
* Review and approve pull requests for database changes, ensuring code quality, standards, and deployability before merge.
* Package database changes (DDL, stored procedures, functions, and CLR/assembly changes) into deployable artifacts using DACPAC, SLN, and manifest files.
* Build, manage, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for database deployments from inception to end of life, using Jenkins and GitHub Actions/Workflows.
* Coordinate database deployments so they roll out alongside production application code changes.
* Apply GitOps principles to database change management, including branching strategy, pull request workflows, and version\-controlled deployment of schema and code changes.
* Use Redgate SQL Compare to identify and validate schema changes as part of the deployment and PR review process.
* Develop and optimize SQL and T\-SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, and other database objects.
* Act as the primary database support resource for lower/lab environments, troubleshooting deployment\-related issues as well as general database issues.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL Server Replication environments, including Transactional Replication (mandatory) and Merge Replication (mandatory).
* Support and troubleshoot AlwaysOn Availability Groups and other high\-availability solutions.
* Perform database backup, restore, disaster recovery, and routine maintenance activities.
* Perform root cause analysis and resolve database performance bottlenecks.
* Monitor database environments using tools such as SolarWinds DPA or equivalent monitoring platforms.
* Provision, configure, maintain, and support AWS RDS for MySQL and Amazon Aurora (MySQL\-compatible) database environments.
* Troubleshoot and maintain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages and ETL workflows.
* Partner with R\&D architects and developers to define database deployment standards and best practices across SQL Server and Amazon Aurora RDS.
* Develop automation scripts and operational tooling, primarily using Python (PowerShell as needed).
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the database deployment pipeline and operational practices.


**Have you got what it takes?** 
  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of professional experience in database engineering or administration, with strong exposure to DevOps/CI\-CD practices.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and T\-SQL programming.
* Solid understanding of DevOps and GitOps principles as applied to database change management.
* Experience performing code reviews and approving pull requests for database changes.
* Hands\-on experience deploying database changes, including DDL, stored procedures, and functions.
* Experience with CLR/Assembly deployment is a plus.
* Fundamental understanding of DACPAC, SLN, and manifest files, and how they're used to package database changes into a deployable artifact for release alongside application code.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools, specifically Jenkins and GitHub Actions/Workflows, and comfort building and managing pipelines from inception through end of life.
* Solid experience with Git\-based source control workflows, including branching, merging, pull requests, and code review.
* Experience with Redgate SQL Compare or similar schema comparison tooling; familiarity with Flyway, Liquibase, or similar database deployment/migration tools is a plus.
* Strong experience with SQL Server Replication:
+ Transactional Replication (mandatory)
+ Merge Replication (mandatory)

* Hands\-on expertise in high availability, including AlwaysOn Availability Groups troubleshooting.
* Experience with database backup, restore, disaster recovery, and root cause analysis.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS RDS and Aurora MySQL (mandatory).
* Experience supporting and troubleshooting SSIS packages and ETL processes.
* Strong experience with scripting and automation using Python (PowerShell a plus).
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as SolarWinds DPA or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services and/or Microsoft Azure is an advantage.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and provisioning tools such as AWS CloudFormation and Spacelift is an advantage.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


**What’s in it for you?**
 You'll work alongside engineers and architects who own database deployment tooling end to end, with room to shape how database changes ship into production.
   

  

 This role offers opportunities to:
   

  

* Build and own database CI/CD pipelines, applying DevOps/GitOps practices to how database changes ship.
* Work across SQL Server, AWS RDS, and Amazon Aurora.
* Collaborate with global teams and R\&D stakeholders on deployment tooling and day\-to\-day database support.
* Build expertise in CI/CD, release engineering, replication, and high\-availability architectures.
* Grow into Senior, Lead, and Principal\-level roles as you build your track record here.


**Enjoy FLEX!**
 At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work each week.
   

  

 Office days are focused on face\-to\-face collaboration, technical discussions, teamwork, and innovation, creating a vibrant and interactive environment where new ideas and problem\-solving thrive. This flexible work model helps teams stay connected while also supporting work\-life balance and productivity.
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 11244
   

  

**Reporting into:** 
 Technical Manager.
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Individual Contributor
   

  

**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Lead Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 Simplify Group (The Most Group Inc.) is a high\-growth healthcare technology organisation operating three entities: Simplify Healthcare — a leading healthcare payer SaaS platform serving large US health plans; SimplifyX™ — an AI\-powered clinical automation and innovation product; and Simplify Alpha — a clinical intelligence and analytics platform.  The Lead Cloud Platform Engineer is a senior individual contributor who serves as the primary cloud platform owner for an assigned entity (Simplify Healthcare, SimplifyX™, or Simplify Alpha). Reporting to the Manager — Platform Engineering IT, the role owns cloud infrastructure design, CI/CD pipelines, reliability engineering, cost governance, and security posture for their assigned environment. The role requires both deep technical execution and the ability to lead within a team — setting standards, mentoring junior engineers, and acting as the platform partner to development and product teams. The Lead Cloud Platform Engineer reduces delivery friction, removes back\-and\-forth between dev and infrastructure, and builds platforms that development teams are proud to deploy on.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Cloud infrastructure design
* CI/CD pipelines
* Reliability engineering
* Cost governance
* Security posture management
* Mentoring junior engineers
* Acting as the platform partner to development and product teams



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering.

* Security certification preferred: CompTIA Security\+, AZ\-500 (Azure Security Engineer) or equivalent.

**Required Skills** 




  





  




* 4–8 years in cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure — with at least 2 years in a senior or lead individual contributor capacity on Azure.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
**Location: Pune**
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Modulr is a B2B embedded\-payments platform operating at scale in a regulated environment. As we evolve our core data architecture, we’re hiring our first dedicated Database Reliability Engineer to raise the operational resilience of our payments platform.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who thinks like a Site Reliability Engineer but has deep database expertise — someone who wants to make a large, busy production estate observable, diagnosable, and safe to operate, and to be the database voice that shapes how we scale. It carries a clear path toward a data\-architecture mandate as the platform matures.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the reliability, performance, and observability of our production databases (primarily PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora), so that issues are seen and understood in minutes, not hours.
* Lead deep\-dive diagnosis of production incidents — query performance, lock and wait\-event analysis, connection\-pool behaviour, blocking sessions — and turn findings into lasting fixes and runbooks.
* Build proactive guardrails: query and statement timeouts, connection\-pool standards, slow\-query and contention alerting, capacity and saturation monitoring.
* Partner with engineering squads to design schemas, indexes, and access patterns that scale, and to enforce safe database practices in their services.
* Contribute the database\-reliability perspective to significant platform\-evolution work, including separation of read and write paths and the decomposition of shared database components.
* Improve our database observability tooling and dashboards so reliability is measurable and trends are visible before they become incidents.
* Help embed a culture of operational excellence, blameless post\-incident review, and continuous improvement.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Substantial hands\-on experience operating production PostgreSQL (Aurora / RDS a strong plus) at meaningful scale.
* Genuine SRE mindset: comfortable with observability tooling, metrics and tracing, alerting, automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code — not just database administration.
* Demonstrable strength in performance diagnosis: reading query plans, identifying lock contention and blocking, resolving connection\-pool exhaustion, and tuning for throughput and latency.
* Experience supporting high\-availability, low\-tolerance systems where correctness and uptime both matter.
* Clear, calm communicator who can lead a live incident and explain root cause to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash) and working familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes\-based environments.


**Desired**
* Exposure to payments, fintech, or other regulated, high\-availability domains.
* Experience with data\-observability or lineage tooling and with connection\-management layers such as PgBouncer / RDS Proxy.
* Familiarity with decomposing monolithic databases and introducing read/write separation.


**ModInclusion**
 Modulr is a leading fintech platform providing Payments Automation and enterprise payment solutions. We serve high\-growth businesses across multiple verticals including Lending, Travel, Banking, and Core Business Payments, operating across India, the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our mission is to simplify and automate payments for our customers, and we're building a diverse, talented team to support that mission. Our people are central to our success, and we're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
**Job Description**
 Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune
   

  

 Senior Vice President
   

  

 Pune, India
   

  

**About Infrastructure Technology**
 The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.
   

  

**Core Infrastructure Platforms**
 The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.
   

  

 Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.
   

  

 By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIPteam and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).
   

  

 This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Global Platform Leadership: partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Local Management of the Infrastructure Team: direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption: Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* Hands\-on Technical Escalation: Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* Solution Delivery: Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* Operational Resilience: Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* Global Team Development: Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* Technical Standards \& Documentation: Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* Post\-Incident Review \& Learning: Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* Regulatory \& Risk Alignment: Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.


**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience:
+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.

* Core Competencies:
+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.

* Certifications (optional, but valued):
+ Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.


**What Success Looks Like**
 The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
 Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
   

  

 Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Senior Analyst - Incident Management
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
   

  

**Critical Incident Manager (CIM)**
**Location: Pune / Hybrid**
**Role Purpose**
 As an
 **Critical** 
**Incident Manager (CIM)** 
 , you will lead the end\-to\-end management of business\-critical and high\-visibility production incidents, ensure rapid restoration of services and minimizing customer impact. You will direct incident response activities, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and drive effective communication strategies throughout the incident lifecycle.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and managing P1/P2 incidents, ensuring timely resolution within SLA commitments, driving structured incident governance, and maintaining alignment between technical teams, business stakeholders, and customers.
   

  

 This position will be responsible for incident management, stakeholder communication, operational governance, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement. The focus will be on ensuring operational resilience, maintaining customer trust, improving service reliability, and driving proactive incident prevention initiatives in line with
 **Accelya's global business strategy, values, and mission.**
**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Incident Ownership \& Lifecycle Management**
* Own and manage the lifecycle of critical P1/P2 and high\-priority incidents from detection through resolution and closure.
* Act as the primary escalation point for major incidents, ensuring timely engagement of appropriate stakeholders and technical teams.
* Perform impact assessments, severity classification, and incident prioritization to ensure effective response execution.
* Drive production fixes, workarounds, and mitigation plans required to restore services.


**Incident Coordination \& Bridge Management**
* Assemble and lead Incident Response Teams (IRT) across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, DevOps, and Support functions.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage incident bridge calls, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and progress tracking.
* Remove operational roadblocks and maintain resolution momentum throughout the incident lifecycle.


**Stakeholder \& Customer Communication**
* Provide timely, accurate, and structured communications to customers, leadership teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure communication consistency across customer notifications, management updates, bridge calls, and service status channels.
* Manage communications for high\-impact incidents affecting strategic customers and business\-critical operations.


**Status Page \& Customer Transparency**
* Own customer\-facing status page updates for all major incidents.
* Publish clear incident updates outlining customer impact, affected services, mitigation activities, and recovery progress.
* Maintain defined communication cadence throughout incident management and restoration activities.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across all communication channels.


**RCA \& Problem Management**
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) creation, review, quality assurance, and timely delivery.
* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to eliminate underlying causes.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.


**Monitoring, Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively monitor service health and operational alerts to identify potential service disruptions.
* Lead Daily Operations Reviews (DORs), providing updates on incident trends, risks, and operational performance.
* Analyze incident patterns and service trends to identify stability improvements and automation opportunities.
* Support enhancements in monitoring, alerting, reporting dashboards, and operational tooling.
* Maintain audit\-ready incident documentation across Zendesk, Jira, RCA repositories, and reporting systems.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Product, DevOps, and Support teams to improve service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with external vendors and technology partners during critical incidents when required.
* Ensure accountability, ownership, and adherence to escalation processes across all stakeholder groups.


**Operational Excellence**
* Drive accountability throughout incident management, ensuring timely service restoration and closure.
* Participate in a 24x7 rotational on\-call support model to provide uninterrupted major incident coverage.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer\-first service delivery.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Proven experience in Major Incident Management, Service Operations, Production Support, IT Service Management, or Site Reliability Operations.
* Strong experience managing critical P1/P2 incidents in complex enterprise or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional technical teams during high\-pressure incident situations.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management processes aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Experience conducting incident triage, impact assessments, severity classification, and escalation management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and problem management initiatives.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based environments, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management tools such as Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred Experience \& Skills**
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Experience supporting airline, travel technology, SaaS, or mission\-critical enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or cloud\-native operational environments.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
* Experience driving automation initiatives within operational support environments.
* Exposure to SRE, DevOps, Problem Management, and Change Management practices.
* Experience creating executive dashboards and operational reporting metrics.

* Flexible working hours
* Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment
* Work\-life balance
* Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure.  A Day in the Life
   

  

 Our Global Diabetes Capability Center in Pune is expanding to serve more people living with diabetes globally. Our state\-of\-the\-art facility is dedicated to transforming diabetes management through innovative solutions and Technologies that reduce the burden of living with diabetes.
   

  

 This position is an exciting opportunity to work with Minimed’s Diabetes business. Medtronic has announced its intention to separate the Diabetes division to promote future growth and innovation within the business and reallocate investments and resources across Medtronic, subject to applicable information and consultation requirements. This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.
   

  

 \#BetterDaysStartNow
   

  

 DevOps \+ Automation Engineer with a proven track record of managing and automating end\-to\-end CI/CD lifecycles in a fast\-paced environment or in regulated industries (such as Medical Devices, Aerospace, or Automotive).
   

  

 Responsible for designing, automating and maintaining robust build pipelines, automating software control (SCM) processes, and seamlessly integrating automated testing frameworks—including Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) environments. A critical part of this role will be automating compliance reporting, code quality gates (MISRA/SAST), and audit trail documentation to conform with medical device standards like IEC 62304\.
   

  

* End\-to\-End Regulated SCM \& Gatekeeping: Expert\-level mastery of Git workflows (GitLab/GitHub) configured with strict, automated compliance gates to guarantee absolute audit trails and change control.
* Continuous Compliance \& Automated DHF Reporting: Hands\-on ability to automate code quality scans (MISRA/SAST) and auto\-generate audit\-ready test reports for the Design History File (DHF) to satisfy IEC 62304 and FDA requirements.
* Hardware \& Software\-in\-the\-Loop Integration: Proven experience bridging the digital\-to\-physical gap by integrating virtual hardware emulators (like Renode) and physical HIL test fleets directly into the automated CI/CD pipeline.
* Robust Multi\-Platform Build Orchestration: Deep expertise building reusable, scalable pipelines (GitLab CI/GitHub Actions) capable of handling both cloud services and low\-level embedded/firmware cross\-compilation toolchains.
* CI/CD Orchestration: Deep expertise in GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions, with an emphasis on building reusable, modular, and secure pipeline templates.
* Pipeline/Lab Observability: Establishing dashboards (Elasticsearch, Grafana, or native tool reporting) to monitor pipeline health, test pass/fail trends, and build performance metrics.
* Multi\-Platform Compilation: Experience managing build toolchains for cross\-compilation (e.g., GCC, Clang, IAR, Keil for ARM/STM32/Nordic microcontrollers).
* Artifact Lifecycle: Strong management of secure artifact repositories (JFrog Artifactory, Nexus, or native GitLab/GitHub package registries) with strict versioning and immutable release tagging.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible to manage physical or virtual build agents/runners reliably.
* Traceability Automation via Tooling: Skilled at using APIs and manifest files to programmatically link requirements (Jira) to source code and test execution results, eliminating manual mapping errors.
* Python (and frameworks), Yaml, React, AI\+MCP\+RAG etc. (Nice to have)


 Responsibilities may include the following, and other duties may be assigned.
   

  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Work with cloud
* Utilize multi\-cloud infrastructure as code (IAC) and application deployment skills.
* Develop and manage software configuration management plans (SCMP) for product development.
* Automate SCM workflows with scripts for end\-to\-end pipelines and compliance.
* Enhance developer experience through engineering tools for productivity, quality, and test automation in the SDLC.
* Improve product quality and development efficiency by implementing new tools.
* Scale and architect CI/CD workflows.
* Provide DevOps coaching and support.
* Responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and fixing code and deployment errors on Linux and Windows.
* Generates systems software engineering policies, standards and procedures.

* Significant experience in production test automation within CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfortable working in command\-line environments on Windows, Linux, and MacOS; system administration is a plus.
* Experience in Docker, Git/GitHub, Artifactory, Ansible, Terraform, AWS, Azure DevOps, and Kubernetes.
* Seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer focused on operational excellence through automation.

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

 We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer with experience in Java, Spring Boot, and microservices, combined with exposure to DevOps and cloud environments. The position involves both backend and front\-end development, as well as collaboration within hybrid agile delivery models.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to work on modern microservices and cloud\-based architectures
* Exposure to DevOps practices and enterprise\-scale systems
* Collaborative working environment focused on innovation and continuous improvement
* Access to learning platforms and opportunities to gain industry\-relevant certifications
* Experience of working within globally distributed teams and agile frameworks


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced microservices design and distributed system patterns
* DevOps practices including CI/CD, automation, and cloud deployment

* Agile delivery methodologies at scale (SAFe, Scrum, Kanban)

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

title: Software Engineer II - DevOps
description:

 **Software Engineer II** 
 . In this role, you will take ownership of the platform and infrastructure your teams build on, working with cutting\-edge technologies, receiving coaching and support to reach your full potential, and helping establish our foundational engineering presence in the region.

 Our Product and Engineering team builds award\-winning solutions on the Insight platform to help over 10,000 global organizations assess risk, detect threats, and automate security programs. Working with best\-in\-class technology, leading\-edge research, and broad strategic expertise, our global teams continuously innovate to deliver a cohesive, highly reliable security platform.

 As a Platform Operations Engineer II, your primary responsibility will be to ensure our products deliver a secure, available, reliable, and scalable experience, with a particular focus on our FedRAMP authorized environment. Specifically, your focus will be to:
   

  

* Build, operate, and scale the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines that our product teams depend on.

* Learn and take ownership of existing platform systems, operational workflows, and runbooks.
